Create a graph-owned release group without activating its members.

## Import

```ts
import { topology } from "@graphrefly/ts/graph";
```

## Signature

```ts
namespace topology {
	function group(
		graph: Graph,
		opts: TopologyGroupOptions = {},
	): TopologyGroup
}
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `graph` | `Graph` | Graph that owns every member node. |
| `opts` | `TopologyGroupOptions` | Optional diagnostic group name. |

## Returns

A group for quiescent release of its graph-registered members.

## Example

```ts
const g = graph();
const tasks = topology.group(g, { name: "tasks" });
tasks.state(0);
tasks.release();
```
